phases.name: AMPUTATION — Remove Dead Webapp Code
phases.rationale: 44K lines of dead Express server, 90 dead npm deps, 17 redundant auth files, dead Drizzle ORM. All must go BEFORE any feature work.

tasks.title: Evacuate Rust kernels from server/
tasks.detail: Move server/kernels/ to packages/terrabuild/kernels/ (top-level). This is the ONLY live code in server/.
tasks.verify: Cargo.toml still references both crates, cargo check passes

tasks.title: Delete entire server/ directory
tasks.detail: 127 TS files, 43,799 lines. Includes: Express app (index.ts), auth (auth.ts, county-auth.ts, replitAuth.ts, replitAuth_final.ts), 7 storage implementations, MCP agents (31 files/15,147 lines), Drizzle DB (db.ts), controllers, services, middleware, routes, socket, feature-flags, calculationEngine, monitoringRoutes, scripts/setupSupabase.ts. ALL DEAD — Express never runs, port 5000 conflicts with .NET.
tasks.verify: server/ directory no longer exists, vite dev server still starts

tasks.title: Delete shared/schema.ts (dead Drizzle ORM schema)
tasks.detail: 753 lines. Header says 'BCBS Application Database Schema'. Defines users, sessions, properties, improvements, costMatrix, landDetails, buildingTypes, regions — complete parallel data model that duplicates .NET EF Core schema. 15 frontend files import from @shared/schema.
tasks.verify: File deleted, all @shared/schema imports replaced

tasks.title: Replace 15 @shared/schema imports with TS interfaces
tasks.detail: Create packages/terrabuild/client/src/types/api.ts with TypeScript interfaces matching .NET DTO contracts. Update all 15 files that import from @shared/schema.
tasks.verify: grep -r '@shared/schema' client/src/ returns 0 results

tasks.title: Gut package.json — remove ~85 dead dependencies
tasks.detail: Remove all Express/server deps (express, express-session, express-rate-limit, express-validator, passport, passport-local, connect-pg-simple, memorystore, multer, cors, ws), all Drizzle deps (drizzle-orm, drizzle-zod, drizzle-kit), all dead DB drivers (pg, postgres, @neondatabase/serverless, @supabase/supabase-js, mssql), all Replit plugins (@replit/vite-plugin-*), server-side tools (basic-ftp, autocannon), duplicate AI SDKs (openai, @anthropic-ai/sdk — backend handles AI), broken ref (rest-express), dead test frameworks (mocha, chai, sinon, supertest, jest — keep vitest only). KEEP: aframe, aframe-react, ar.js, three (live showcase features).
tasks.verify: pnpm install succeeds, vite dev server starts, no import errors in client/src

tasks.title: Fix build scripts in package.json
tasks.detail: dev should be 'vite' (not concurrently with Express). Remove dev:server, build:server, db:push, start (Express production). Keep dev:client → rename to dev.
tasks.verify: pnpm run dev starts Vite only, no Express reference in scripts

tasks.title: Delete 16 of 17 auth files (keep OsContext.tsx)
tasks.detail: DELETE: contexts/auth-context.tsx, contexts/AuthContext.tsx, contexts/enhanced-auth-provider.tsx, hooks/use-auth.ts, hooks/use-auth.tsx, hooks/useAuth.ts, hooks/use-auto-login-client.ts, hooks/use-autologin.ts, lib/devAuth.ts, utils/localStorageAuth.ts, components/auth/protected-route.tsx, components/auth/county-network-auth.tsx, components/auth/auth-error-boundary.tsx, pages/auth-page.tsx, pages/login-page.tsx, pages/register-page.tsx, dashboard/AutoLogin.tsx. KEEP: contexts/OsContext.tsx (the correct OS auth).
tasks.verify: No import of deleted auth files remains in any .tsx/.ts file

tasks.title: Rewire all auth consumers to OsContext
tasks.detail: Every component/page that imports useAuth, AuthProvider, AuthContext, ProtectedRoute, etc. must be updated to use useOsContext() instead. OsContext already has osUser and isOsAuthenticated. Dev mode auto-provides a dev user. Update App.tsx to remove AuthProvider wrapping, remove /auth /login /register routes.
tasks.verify: grep -r 'useAuth\|AuthProvider\|ProtectedRoute\|auth-context\|AuthContext\|enhanced-auth' client/src/ returns only OsContext references

tasks.title: Delete Replit/Supabase/Neon artifacts
tasks.detail: Delete: SupabaseErrorBoundary.tsx, SupabaseTestPage.tsx (if exists). Remove any import/reference to Replit-specific env detection (REPLIT_DOMAINS, isReplit checks) from client code. Remove @replit/* from vite.config.ts plugins if referenced.
tasks.verify: grep -ri 'replit\|supabase' client/src/ returns 0 results (excluding node_modules)

tasks.title: Remove Vite @shared alias (points to dead shared/)
tasks.detail: vite.config.ts has alias '@shared' → 'shared/'. After schema.ts is deleted and imports replaced, remove this alias.
tasks.verify: vite.config.ts has no @shared alias, vite dev server starts clean

phases.name: BACKEND — Fix .NET API (Stop the Bleeding)
phases.rationale: 24 broken endpoints. Fix begins with rebuilding the stale binary, then DI + missing routes.

tasks.title: Rebuild .NET API (stale binary fix)
tasks.detail: DLL compiled 2026-04-11 00:03:17, controllers modified 11:10-13:28. Running binary doesn't include recent controller changes. Run: dotnet build backend/src/TerraFusion.API -c Release
tasks.verify: dotnet build succeeds, TerraFusion.API.dll timestamp matches current time

tasks.title: Fix IAnalyticsOrchestrator DI registration
tasks.detail: IAnalyticsOrchestrator interface declared in AnalyticsController.cs (lines 258-264) but no implementation or DI registration. Create AnalyticsOrchestratorImpl and register in Program.cs. Unblocks 5 endpoints returning 500.
tasks.verify: GET /api/analytics/market → 200, GET /api/analytics/trends → 200

tasks.title: Add missing analytics endpoints
tasks.detail: Frontend calls 5 analytics URLs with no backend: /api/analytics/cost-breakdown, /api/analytics/time-series, /api/analytics/regional-costs, /api/analytics/hierarchical-costs, /api/analytics/statistical-correlations. Add to AnalyticsController.
tasks.verify: All 5 endpoints return 200 with data

tasks.title: Add missing CostForge endpoints (building-types, regions)
tasks.detail: Frontend calls /api/costforge/building-types and /api/costforge/regions. May exist in source but not in stale binary. Verify after rebuild, add if missing.
tasks.verify: GET /api/costforge/building-types → 200, GET /api/costforge/regions → 200

tasks.title: Verify/fix BenchmarkingController endpoints
tasks.detail: BenchmarkingController.cs was modified after binary build. Rebuild should expose: /api/benchmarking/counties, /api/benchmarking/statistical-data, /api/benchmarking/regional-costs, /api/benchmarking/hierarchical-costs. Verify after rebuild.
tasks.verify: All 4 benchmarking endpoints return 200

tasks.title: Verify/fix WhatIfScenariosController
tasks.detail: WhatIfScenariosController.cs was modified after binary build. Rebuild should expose: GET/POST /api/what-if-scenarios. Verify.
tasks.verify: GET /api/what-if-scenarios → 200

tasks.title: Fix valuations route method mismatch
tasks.detail: Frontend GETs /api/costforge/valuations but backend only has POST (line 1928). HttpGet at line 1979 may be in source but not binary. Verify after rebuild. If still missing, add GET.
tasks.verify: GET /api/costforge/valuations → 200

tasks.title: Fix 403 permission errors on dev token
tasks.detail: Dev token missing permissions for: /api/costforge/metrics (403), /api/aiswarm/status (403), /api/aimodules/status (403). Either add permissions to dev token or relax auth for dev mode.
tasks.verify: All 3 endpoints return 200 with dev token
tasks.evidence: Program.cs /api/auth/dev-token includes read:performance-metrics and GovernmentUser role (satisfies OSCoreAccess policy). Confirmed at Program.cs:1195-1222.

phases.name: FRONTEND — Strip Webapp Chrome + Fix Branding
phases.rationale: BCBS branding on 10 pages, 3 incompatible layout systems, OS module should render zero chrome.

tasks.title: Create ModulePane wrapper component
tasks.detail: Simple scroll container + padding. No header, no sidebar, no nav. CostForge is an OS module — the OS shell provides all chrome.
tasks.verify: File exists, exports ModulePane component

tasks.title: Strip MainLayout to content-only
tasks.detail: Remove TerraFusionHeader and Sidebar from MainLayout. Keep content area + loading/error states. Result should be equivalent to ModulePane with optional content header.
tasks.verify: MainLayout renders no nav/header/sidebar

tasks.title: Convert 10 BCBS pages from LayoutWrapper to ModulePane
tasks.detail: Remove LayoutWrapper/MainContent imports, wrap content in ModulePane. Pages: AIToolsPage, AnalyticsPage, ARVisualizationPage, DataImportPage, documentation, faq, GeoAssessmentPage, MCPVisualizationsPage, PropertyDetailsPage, tutorials.
tasks.verify: No page imports LayoutWrapper or TopNavbar or SimpleTopMenu

tasks.title: Delete BCBS layout components
tasks.detail: Delete: SimpleTopMenu.tsx, TopNavMenu.tsx, TopNavbar.tsx, LayoutWrapper.tsx (or whatever wraps those). These are the BCBS branding vectors.
tasks.verify: grep -ri 'BCBS' client/src/ returns 0 results in active code

tasks.title: Rename BCBSCostCalculatorAPI.tsx
tasks.detail: Component file is still named BCBS*. Rename to CostCalculatorAPI.tsx. Update all imports.
tasks.verify: No file named BCBS* exists in client/src/

tasks.title: Consolidate 34 layout-less pages
tasks.detail: 34 pages render with no layout wrapper at all. Wrap each in ModulePane for consistent padding/scroll. Lower priority — they work, they just look inconsistent.
tasks.verify: Every page in App.tsx uses either ModulePane or stripped MainLayout

phases.name: FRONTEND — Wire to Real .NET API Data
phases.rationale: Most pages show fake/hardcoded/no data. Wire them to the .NET endpoints fixed in P1.

tasks.title: Fix MCPOverviewPage API URLs
tasks.detail: /api/mcp/status → /api/aimodules/status. /api/mcp/dashboard → /api/swarm/status.
tasks.verify: MCPOverviewPage renders with real swarm data

tasks.title: Fix BenchmarkingPage data sources
tasks.detail: Frontend calls /api/costforge/building-types and /api/costforge/regions for data the BenchmarkingController serves at different URLs. Align frontend to backend routes.
tasks.verify: BenchmarkingPage renders with real data from /api/benchmarking/*

tasks.title: Fix AnalyticsPage data sources
tasks.detail: AnalyticsPage calls 9 analytics URLs. 5 don't exist. 4 crash (DI). After P1-02 and P1-03 fix the backend, update any frontend URLs that don't match.

tasks.title: Fix BCBSCostCalculatorAPI useEffect ordering
tasks.detail: CAMA useEffect runs before useForm is initialized. Move it after form declaration.
tasks.verify: No React hook order warning in console

tasks.title: Audit remaining dead data hooks
tasks.detail: After P0-07 deletes auth hooks and P0-04 replaces schema imports, scan remaining hooks for Express-specific endpoints. Hooks: use-api-endpoints, use-building-costs, use-calculation-history, use-cost-factor-presets, use-cost-factors, use-cost-matrix, use-file-uploads, use-users, use-mcp, use-repository, useStorytellingAPI, useConnectionStatus. Update or delete as needed.
tasks.verify: Every hook calls a .NET endpoint that returns 200
